text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN SALE - The Kaohsiung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans from Continental at an unusual invitation-only tender on Friday, traders said.

WHEAT SALE - Private Moroccan importers on Thursday bought a total of 35,000 tonnes of durum wheat for August-September delivery, European grain traders said. They bought 30,000 tonnes of Canadian durum at $230 per tonne, C and F and 5,000 tonnes of Greek durum at $225 a tonne, C and F.
SOYMEAL SALE - The CCC bought 7,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal for donation to Nicaragua. The delivery period was set for August 10-30.

WHEAT TENDERS - Egypt's official commodities buyer said Friday he was seeking 50,000 to 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for delivery in September and October. Samir el-Shakankiri, vice chairman of General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters the deadline for bids was July 26. Earlier this week, Shakankiri tendered for an additional 50,000 tonnes of French wheat. The deadline for these bids is July 27.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking on July 30 up to 3,530 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Honduras. Shipment period was set Aug 15-Sept 5.
- The CCC was seeking on July 29 up to 4,100 tonnes of U.S. Hard Red Winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. Shipment period was slated for Aug 15-Sept 5.
- Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11-Sept 10 shipment.
CORN/SOY TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on July 29 for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 U.S. soybeans, traders said.

VEGOIL TENDER - El Salvador said it was seeking about 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be received by July 29 and remain valid until July 30. The shipment dates for both commodities were slated for September 10-25.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.

MARKET TALK - Pakistan may buy up to 250,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat at a tender set for Monday, but limited GSM-102 credits may restrict the country from buying the full 500,000 tonnes it is seeking, export sources said.
... USDA said Friday Pakistan signed an agreement under Title I of Public Law 480 for the sale of $20 million worth of U.S. wheat or about 110,000 tonnes. The supply period is fiscal 1997, USDA said.

... Philippine grain importers, sidelined by the fall of the peso and high U.S. wheat and corn prices this week, are waiting for prices to soften before going back to the market, traders said. "There could be some activity next week if prices dip to better levels," said an executive in a local flour mill.
... The Philippines needs to import about one million tonnes of corn in 1998 due to a projected production shortfall because of the El Nino weather phenomenon, an industry executive said.
... China has defaulted on soybean meal cargoes, but specific numbers are difficult to pinpoint, grains traders in Hong Kong said on Friday.
... A senior U.S. Agriculture Department official Friday said Egypt's new import ban on genetically altered commodities had been put on hold for three months "for everything but oilseeds."
